verdict.rationale: DBOS's queues provide managed concurrency/flow control across many workflows (dbos-docs-6/26), and Conductor explicitly detects when a workflow's executor disconnects or crashes and recovers it onto another healthy executor (dbos-docs-31), which directly supports fleet-wide load-balancing and worker-loss tolerance. However, community critique raises concerns about worker contention using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and potential Postgres bottlenecks at scale (dbos-comm-6, dbos-comm-7), suggesting real-world scaling limits are not fully proven. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or case studies showing throughput actually scaling linearly with added workers, and resolution/rebuttal of the contention/lock-based scaling concerns.
